# Support

Please use the repository's issue forms for reproducible bugs and feature
requests. Search existing issues first and include the app version, operating
system, reproduction steps, and relevant logs.

For questions and design discussion, open a GitHub Discussion when available.
Do not include dealership locations, customer data, API keys, or other
confidential information in public issues.

Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately through the process in
[`SECURITY.md`](../SECURITY.md).
